usage: cox setup migrate [-h] [--home HOME] [--dry-run] [--apply] [--hosts]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --home HOME  absolute path of the coxswain home to migrate to
  --dry-run    same as the default: print the plans; change nothing
  --apply      execute the plans; without it the command only prints them
  --hosts      with --apply, also run the host steps; use it on the chair's machine
